basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: Investor & AI Engineer | 22% CAGR (USD) / 13 Years | Financial Time-Series, Portfolio Construction, Production Data Pipelines
basics.summary: 13+ years as a self-directed investor with a 22% CAGR (USD) track record built on bottom-up, hypothesis-driven analysis, disciplined portfolio construction and pre-defined risk sizing. Founder of PulseView, a production AI market-intelligence platform that ingests, cleans and normalizes technical and news-based financial time series, computes indicators and generates justified trading signals for a live user base. 13+ years of production data engineering (PostgreSQL, Kafka, ClickHouse, Elastic Search) at Beekeeper and LumApps, including LLM pipelines shipped in 6 weeks that saved $337K. Joining Julius Baer to own the financial time-series backbone of the CIO Office and bring AI leverage to portfolio simulations, index maintenance and UHNW mandate analytics.

work.name: LumApps
highlights: Architected AI Brain, a temporal knowledge graph on Graphiti and Neo4j that unifies 5+ upstream data feeds (CRM, transcripts, product usage) into one time-aware store with per-consumer read/write contracts and a freshness layer that flags stale facts. Same discipline required for a curated financial time-series database.

Built event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub with automated cleaning, deduplication and versioning; production observability, cost-per-request telemetry and on-call ownership. Directly transferable to maintaining and automating market-data feed processes.

Ship quantitative decision-support agents (Python, LangGraph on Vertex AI) that turn raw data into on-demand analyses for internal stakeholders; 2x conversions, $1M/quarter revenue forecast. Report to C-level on outcomes.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
highlights: Owned production data infrastructure on AWS: PostgreSQL, Kafka pipelines, Elastic Search and ClickHouse for high-volume time-series and analytics on 10M+ user events. Downloaded, cleaned, stored and distributed data across dozens of consumers with strict reliability SLAs.
Replaced $337K in annual vendor cost with an in-house LLM pipeline shipped in 6 weeks. Rigorous cost analysis, ruthless prioritization, measurable payback. Same lens I apply to portfolio positions.

Architected the Employee Referral System end-to-end (99.99% SLA, $1.5M+ revenue, $500K ARR) and led the Search Platform revamp across 3 teams: redesigned indexing and ranking to distil large, noisy signal sets into decision-ready output.
Ran observability, on-call and Grafana / Datadog dashboards for global production systems; mentored the AI engineering cohort; presented outcomes to Product, Sales and CIO.

work.name: Tenity
highlights: Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production. Direct exposure to buy-side execution constraints, alpha decay, market microstructure and low-latency data infrastructure.
Technology evaluation panelist for 20+ fintech and AI startups: business models, moats, data architecture and ESG readiness to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.

work.name: Dronistics
highlights: Founding engineer at an EPFL spin-off. Built the end-to-end platform (Vue/Java/PostgreSQL) that ran 500+ real-world deliveries and enabled partnerships with Unilever plus a CES showcase.

Engineered real-time telemetry, flight-control APIs and logistics optimization: 40% faster deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents. Practitioner-level comfort with real-time data streams and optimization under constraints.

education.institution: Quantic School of Business and Technology

publications.summary: AWS reference architecture for a low-latency, scalable service using cloud-native patterns. Demonstrates the plumbing discipline behind reliable production data services.

awards.title: Appreciation from John T. Chambers (ex-CEO, Cisco Systems)

projects.name: PulseView - Production Financial Time-Series & Signals Platform
projects.description: AI-native market intelligence platform I designed, built and run for live retail users. Automated ingest, cleaning and storage of price and news time series from multiple providers; deduplication, corporate-action handling and index-level normalization built in. Downstream: technical indicator computation, signal generation and an agent layer that justifies every signal with cited evidence (if the model cannot explain the signal, it does not ship). Explainability, evaluation and back-testing baked in. A working prototype of the kind of proprietary financial-data tooling the CIO Office maintains.

projects.name: Personal Investing Track Record - 22% CAGR (USD), 13 Years
projects.description: 13+ years managing my own multi-asset portfolio using a bottom-up, quality-at-a-reasonable-price approach with disciplined position sizing and drawdown control. 22% CAGR in USD terms, benchmark-beating across multiple cycles. Every position is underwritten with a written thesis on business model, moat, unit economics, capital allocation and ESG risk, with pre-defined invalidation triggers. Direct proof of portfolio construction, risk sizing and quantitative thinking applied to real capital.

projects.name: Anand Creations - Forward Deployed Engineering Practice
projects.description: Independent FDE practice building proprietary AI and data tools for teams that want leverage. Runs technical discovery, ships production agents with evaluations and observability, and stays accountable to the metric. Same operating model I would bring to the CIO Office's proprietary toolchain: own it, automate it, keep improving it.
